exports.name: CdkMonitorFocus
exports.summary:
Directive that determines how a particular element was focused (via keyboard, mouse, touch, or
programmatically) and adds corresponding classes to the element.

There are two variants of this directive:
1) cdkMonitorElementFocus: does not consider an element to be focused if one of its children is
   focused.
2) cdkMonitorSubtreeFocus: considers an element focused if it or any of its children are focused.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 指令 `CdkMonitorFocus`（selector: '[cdkMonitorElementFocus], [cdkMonitorSubtreeFocus]'），为宿主 DOM 元素附加CDK工具Monitor聚焦行为。

outputs.description: Output event emitter `cdkFocusChange` (`EventEmitter`) firing when cdk focus change occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 输出事件 `cdkFocusChange`（类型：`EventEmitter`），当触发CDK工具聚焦变更时向外发出事件。
